wem.definition:
n. The abdomen; the uterus; the womb.
n. Spot; blemish; harm; hurt.
v. t. To stain; to blemish; to harm; to corrupt.
n. An indolent, encysted tumor of the skin; especially, a
   sebaceous cyst.
